status: Information and behaviour specification only; no storage, scheduler or execution architecture implemented
import_default: recorded with review unknown; completed status is a source job status, never approval

transitions.requires: explicit submission event and immutable candidate version
human scoped changed properties, invariants, source binding and reason
explicit human rejection event; no-use cannot cause transition
explicit human replacement event identifying new approved version; old provenance retained

independent_axes.further_work_use: Observed edge-derived uses coexist with any review state and cannot change it
independent_axes.dependency_review: needs_review with exact causes and Study 07 deduplicated descendant set; no automatic rerun, rejection or approval revocation
independent_axes.canonical_authority: Separate explicit actor/version/property/task/scene/project declaration; task-scoped authority cannot approve a library

revision_rule: A changed prompt, input, model or control creates a new immutable candidate/request version linked to its source and human intended delta; no in-place rewriting or inherited approval

bounded_retry.cap: Positive integer maximum_total_attempts explicitly chosen by a human per task version; no empirically optimal number derived from archive
bounded_retry.gate: Reserve a unique attempt under the total cap before dispatch; record requested versus reported adapter outcome separately
bounded_retry.count: Each dispatched invocation counts, including reruns and interrupted/unknown outcomes; do not infer undisclosed outcome or retry automatically after uncertainty
stop: missing required input or unresolved change scope
bounded_retry.exhaustion: Stop and retain candidates for human review; a reasoned explicit cap-change event is required for further attempts; no model may increase its own cap
bounded_retry.creative_change: New direction, identity/input version or model change requires an explicit human decision and linked task revision; total history is retained rather than silently resetting budget
bounded_retry.transport: A separately declared bounded transport retry policy must account for ambiguous duplicate dispatch; transport retries never count as evidence of creative revision

validation_scenarios: Synthetic reused-unreviewed candidate stays review unknown
Two shared-input jobs with different intended shots remain candidate-only until human confirmation
Approval for one property/version cannot approve another version or the entire project
Diamond dependencies deduplicate review candidates without automatic regeneration
Concurrent synthetic reservations cannot exceed a human cap; interrupted dispatch retains its reservation and stops until reconciled
Cap exhaustion preserves history and requires a named cap-change event
Changed prompt/model/input/control preserves old candidate and its scoped decision
